name: JohannesJanuary/dcf_transcripts
what_it_holds: Python toolkit described as scrapers + CSV builders + summary statistics + preprocessing utilities for 'company-quarter speaker-level transcript data' to support downstream NLP analysis of corporate communication. No stars, unlicensed, not inspected in depth (README/contents not fetched due to search-call budget).
why_useful: Speaker-level (management vs. analyst) transcript parsing is more granular than a flat transcript dump and could be reused to separate ABNB's prepared remarks from Q&A tone, or applied to peer transcripts.
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: Speaker-level (management vs. analyst) transcript parsing is more granular than a flat transcript dump and could be reused to separate ABNB's prepared remarks from Q&A tone, or applied to peer transcripts.

name: cdubiel08/Earnings-Calls-NLP
what_it_holds: 75-star MIT repo: logistic-regression buy/sell/hold classifier trained on earnings-call transcript text NLP features. Highest-starred repo found in this theme; not fetched in depth but is the most-referenced 'classic' earnings-call NLP baseline on GitHub.
why_useful: A well-tested reference implementation for turning transcript text into a tone/sentiment feature set and a return-direction label; useful as a methods citation even though CONTEXT.md already found management-tone constructions not to work for ABNB specifically.
duplicate_of_holding: Management tone as a signal already tested and found not to work (per CONTEXT.md); this is a differently-built construction so still worth a citation, not a re-test.
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: A well-tested reference implementation for turning transcript text into a tone/sentiment feature set and a return-direction label; useful as a methods citation even though CONTEXT.md already found management-tone constructions not to work for ABNB specifically.

name: alali3030/earnings_calls_NLP
what_it_holds: 34-star MIT repo extracting 'digital transformation strategy' of Fortune 500 companies from earnings-call transcripts — a topic-extraction/classification method over a Fortune 500 transcript set (source/years not confirmed).
why_useful: A topic-extraction methodology (not just sentiment) that could be repointed at ABNB/peer transcripts for strategy-shift signals (e.g. RNPL rollout, international mix commentary) rather than raw tone.

name: ahdithanu/earnings-call-nlp-risk-signals
what_it_holds: MIT repo applying the Loughran-McDonald uncertainty/hedging dictionary to NVIDIA and Microsoft transcripts, correlating hedging-language frequency with revenue performance.
why_useful: Reusable, well-cited Loughran-McDonald word-list application pattern for a hedging/uncertainty score, which is a differently-constructed management-tone metric than what CONTEXT.md says already failed (composite sentiment/tone indexes); could be re-tried on ABNB transcripts using this dictionary-count approach specifically.
duplicate_of_holding: Management tone already tested and found not to work on our constructions; this is a specific dictionary-based construction, still just a method citation, not a new dataset.
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora

name: Cubiczan/earnings-call-nlp-lab
what_it_holds: MIT 'Earnings Call NLP Lab': management tone, confidence, evasiveness scoring, and longitudinal (multi-quarter) transcript tracking for a single company across calls. A near-identical fork/parallel repo exists at icohangar-ops/earnings-call-nlp-lab (updated 13 Sep 2026, one day before this scout ran).
why_useful: Evasiveness/confidence scoring across a longitudinal (quarter-over-quarter) series is a more specific construction than plain sentiment; could be applied to ABNB's own transcript history (which we already hold) to build a QoQ tone-drift feature distinct from the tried-and-failed composite index.
duplicate_of_holding: Tone/composite index already tested and found not predictive; flagging only because the longitudinal evasiveness construction is specifically different from what was tried.
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
